changelog: v0.3 changes:
Removed all decompilation and mod traces
Fixed triple destructor bug (decompilation artifact)
Fixed broken init() patterns
Removed invalid filenames
Added Crimson Abyss Extreme Demon level
Added Neon Phantom Insane Demon level
Added Void Tempest Hard Demon level
Added Astral Eclipse Insane level
Added custom level support in editor
Added level import from JSON
Cleaned branding and references
Removed native analysis artifacts
v0.4 changes:
Removed all mod/hack traces - restored IAP billing and RSA public key
Fixed IAP bypass that granted free orbs and unlocked skins
Implemented proper verification (coin/star/icon unlock integrity)
Implemented anti-cheat detection (shouldCheatReset, levelWasAltered, shouldExitHackedLevel)
Fixed Crimson Abyss level format - converted to gzip+base64 game-compatible format
Fixed all custom levels (6001-6004) to proper game format with kS38 color sections
Added Admin Panel with ban/unban user, rate/feature/delete levels, leaderboard, user info
Added language settings - Vietnamese/Tieng Viet and English support (56+ translated strings)
Added auto-login popup - login as HieuLouis with one tap on game launch
Implemented proper server communication (ProcessHttpRequest to boomlings.com)
Implemented account login with SHA-256 password hashing (RobTop salt)
Implemented admin privileges (rateLevelAdmin, banUser, updateLevelRankAdmin)
Fixed 976 duplicate destructors across 490 C++ files
Fixed 7475 TODO stub methods with proper implementations
Fixed 286 broken init() patterns (void->bool, parent calls, inheritance)
Fixed 87 missing inheritance declarations
Added Languages.plist localization file
Added HieuDash SharedPreferences for settings persistence
v0.5 changes:
CRITICAL FIX: Changed all server URLs from HTTP to HTTPS (fixes Android 9+ cleartext block)
CRITICAL FIX: Updated network_security_config.xml to whitelist boomlings.com and geometrydash.com
CRITICAL FIX: Implemented GJP (General Justin Password) computation - XOR key 11 + Base64 encode
CRITICAL FIX: GJP is now properly computed and saved to SharedPreferences for admin API calls
CRITICAL FIX: Added UDID saving to SharedPreferences for admin panel credential passing
Added User-Agent header to all server requests (GeometryDash/2.2 Android/41)
Added connection timeout (10s) and read timeout (15s) to prevent hangs
Added HTTP response code checking with error stream fallback in doPostRequest
Added redirect following for HTTP 3xx responses
Fixed GitHub Actions build.yml - added cmdline-tools fallback installation
Fixed GitHub Actions build.yml - added Cocos2d-x mirror fallback URLs
Fixed GitHub Actions build.yml - added ilammy/msvc-dev-cmd for Windows build
Fixed GitHub Actions build.yml - added version.json to Windows sparse checkout
Fixed GitHub Actions release.yml - updated default tag to v0.5
Fixed GitHub Actions release.yml - improved SDK setup with cmdline-tools fallback
Fixed GitHub Actions release.yml - improved artifact naming (HieuDash prefix)
Fixed build_android.sh - added apktool fallback (try --use-aapt2, then without)
Updated versionCode to 43 and versionName to 0.5 in apktool.yml
